int_name: N AMERICAN ST & W LUZERNE ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and a curb ramp with tactile paving, but lacks active traffic controls or signage. The wide roadway and industrial land use suggest a design focused on vehicle throughput, which may lead to higher speeds and increased risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a two-lane roadway without the protection of a traffic signal, stop sign, or warning beacons.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signage
hazards.description: There are no signs alerting drivers to the presence of the crosswalk, reducing driver awareness.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at the uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility 'Pedestrian Crossing' signs (W11-2) to alert motorists.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a high-visibility continental crosswalk but lacks signalized control or traffic calming measures. The industrial setting and wide roadway suggest a priority for vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: A wide marked crosswalk across a two-lane road without stop signs, signals, or warning beacons.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The large white structure on the left corner may block the view of pedestrians for drivers approaching from that side.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway in one movement without a protected waiting area.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at the uncontrolled crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The environment is predominantly industrial, characterized by a high masonry wall topped with barbed wire and a lack of dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. The existing walkway is extremely narrow, obstructed by utility poles, and lacks marked crossings or curb ramps, creating a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross an unmarked intersection without any designated space or priority.

hazards.name: Obstructed walkway
hazards.description: Utility poles and signs are placed directly in the narrow paved path, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the wall

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: The road and walkway surfaces are cracked and uneven, increasing the risk of trips and falls.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the roadway and narrow walkway

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Improvements
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and relocate obstructions to provide a continuous, accessible path separated from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection to ensure accessibility for all users.

result.summary: The environment is a predominantly industrial corridor with limited pedestrian infrastructure and faded pavement markings. While a sidewalk exists on one side, the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput with minimal protection or visibility for people walking.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings across the side entrance are significantly worn, reducing visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Continuous Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the roadway lacks a clear, paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk near the travel lane against a high wall.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway along the stone wall

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Fencing and parked vehicles in the adjacent lot may obscure sightlines between pedestrians and vehicles turning into or out of the side entrance.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the property line

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and curb ramps at the crossing point to ensure accessibility.
